description.value: Nesters Liquor Store is the largest locally owned private liquor store in Whistler, tracing its roots to the mid-1990s Boot Cold Beer and Wine Store and carrying the same iconic ski-boot logo since 1966. The shop stocks an extensive range of BC and imported wines, craft beers, and spirits, and is well-regarded among locals and visitors for staff expertise and custom-order capability. A delivery service runs daily and will bring orders directly to hotels, condos, and homes across the resort.

address.value: Unit 101 - 7015 Nesters Road, Whistler, British Columbia, V8E 0X1
